SELECT s.store_key, s.store_id, s.store_name, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.is_current, s.close_date, p.product_key, p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, p.valid_from AS pvf, p.valid_to AS pvt, p.is_current AS pcur, p.delisted_on
FROM dim_store s CROSS JOIN dim_product p
WHERE (s.store_name ILIKE '%Palokka%' OR s.store_name ILIKE '%Jyv%') AND p.sku = 100011
ORDER BY s.store_key, p.product_key

calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, store_key, product_key, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units, etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30'
ORDER BY week_ending_date, etl_loaded_at

SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(distinct (store_key, product_key)) AS d, max(etl_loaded_at) AS mx, min(etl_loaded_at) AS mn
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-06'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold, count(*) AS lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=124 AND p.sku=100011 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date, d.day_name
FROM dim_date d WHERE d.calendar_date IN (DATE '2026-10-04', DATE '2026-10-08', DATE '2026-10-05')
